_readme: S745 SkyTattler, 2026-11-27. Sam asked what it takes to show three outside tools in CPL Pathways' bottom bar, the way the MAP landing page shows there: Program Pathways Mapper's program maps (programmapper.org/ppm-schools/?search=Bakersfield and a college's own map site), the CVC Exchange's course search (cvc.edu/students, its keyword search) and ASSIST (assist.org and its AI Transfer Articulation and Exploration tool). For each page this read asks two things: does it take a deep link (the address its own search builds, from the data its scripts fetch and its forms), and may another site show it in a frame (frame_check: X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors). Reads only; no model call.

outside_hosts.programmapper.org: Program Pathways Mapper's partner directory, which links each college's program map site
outside_hosts.cvc.edu: the CVC Exchange: its students page and course search (search.cvc.edu)
outside_hosts.search.cvc.edu: the CVC Exchange course search the students page submits to
outside_hosts.assist.org: ASSIST, the state's transfer articulation system, and its AI Transfer Articulation and Exploration tool

questions.deep_link: What address does the page's own search build for a college, a program or a course?
questions.frame: May another site show the page in a frame?
